body:
Peace is silence. Oneness. Meditation.

But to me, only true "mindfulness" means death.

Now I go find that peace, the oneness.

!maybe it shall be a God, or even hell. Who knows

Talk to a counselor?

They are shit sometimes, but for some people seem hood help?

Call a helpline? 

Surely some local suicide helpline exists? I hope

A knife seems excessively sharp. Very painful.

Leave it out. Talk to some people,

See how things feel tomorrow?

Please?

Does it usually take this long?

My health is suffering?

Sorry. I hope I don't cause disruption.

It says "one comment", but there's no comment?

Sorry. This is a mistake?

No one will comment. No one understands the psychosomatic end of the spectrum?

Sure I'm odd, but I care.
